name: httpfetch
description: Bounded, injection-safe, cancellable D HTTP(S) fetch: one call, one fetch, typed caps on every dimension (timeouts, redirects, header/body bytes, concurrency), mandatory TLS verification with no disable path. Raw libcurl FFI bindings ship too, for callers who want low-level access.
preBuildCommands: uname -s | grep -qx Darwin && uname -m | grep -qx arm64
